purpose: Five visual concept previews; synthetic demo data, not implemented interfaces.

concepts.name: GRAPHITE
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate ONE exceptionally polished, believable desktop product UI design for DashAI, a local project/task/documentation workspace for a human working with coding agents. This is a design concept, not a live connection. Landscape 1920x1200 or similar readable wide aspect. Flat straight-on app screenshot, edge-to-edge, no monitor, no browser chrome, no perspective, no collage, no surrounding poster. All important interface text in correct legible Russian; brand DashAI. Thoughtful real interaction layout, crisp icons, excellent spacing and hierarchy, realistic 15-16px equivalent body type, at most 2 lines per task title.
Project: “DashAI / Обновление интерфейса”. Navigation must offer “Задачи”, “Документация”, “Карта проекта”, “Версии”, “История”; “Коннекторы” secondary. One prominent primary action “Новая задача”. Search “Поиск задач”, board/list toggle “Доска / Список”, filters by assignee and priority. Keep the underlying model: ONE project board with 5 explicit textual statuses “Очередь”, “В работе”, “Проверка”, “Готово”, “Блокировка”. No lanes by department, no sections pretending to be separate boards. Tasks show a small ID, clear title, type and assignee name, at most one extra meaningful indicator.
Synthetic sample data: DA-101 “Поиск по документации”, DA-102 “Навигация по проектам”, DA-103 “Новый вид карточек”, DA-104 “Сохранение фильтров”, DA-105 “Проверка экспорта PDF”, DA-106 “Контраст и фокус”, DA-107 “История изменений”, DA-108 “Настройка коннектора”. Assigned to “Codex”, “Claude”, “Вы” or “Не назначен”; these are identity labels only, NO online dots or running-agent claims. For a board, columns contain 2,2,2,1,1 tasks respectively; small summary “8 задач · 2 на проверке · 1 блокировка”. For list/attention layout keep the same statuses on tasks. Blocked connector task gives “Ожидает настройки”. Any evidence summary says “Отчёт автора” rather than claiming independently verified tests.
Must feel genuinely usable, desirable, complete, carefully art-directed. No marketing hero, huge useless metrics, charts, AI chat box, token costs, robots, glowing brains, generic bento KPIs, decorations stealing task space, tiny unreadable gray text or pseudo-text. A subtle footer label “Концепт · демоданные” plus the concept number/name specified below.
Direction 01 — GRAPHITE. Sophisticated dark graphite and fresh mint. A highly refined productivity workspace with 214px left navigation, strong restrained DashAI brand, project switcher and 3 small project names. Main canvas near-black #101315, sidebar #14191b, cards #1b2224, thin warm gray strokes, mint #bbefac only for main CTA and selected items. Muted blue, amber, lilac and mint tiny status dots always with text labels. Main top area is COMPACT: breadcrumb, project title, understated 8-task summary, one clear CTA. Project tabs then a single tidy filter row. Five equally spaced independent kanban columns dominate the screen with eight beautifully typeset task cards. 10px radius, tiny soft shadows, generous card interior spacing, large task names, subtle hairlines. Plenty of breathing room under short columns. Bottom-left user avatar and settings. Bottom-right “01 / GRAPHITE”. Aesthetic: premium calm dark software, disciplined, human, not cyberpunk. Design the final UI, not an illustration.

Direction 02 — PAPER. A warm light editorial workspace, fundamentally different from a dark card dashboard. Cream #f6f4ef canvas, white reading surface, ink #20241f type, fine neutral rules and muted deep forest #3d6652 interactive accent. Very slim 76px icon rail with tooltips represented as simple labels in active area, then 185px project/navigation pane. Elegant editorial serif used ONLY for the project heading, everything interactive clean humanist sans-serif. Spacious but efficient, flat dividers rather than cards inside cards, 6px subtle radius. Primary green “Новая задача”. No huge greeting. A quiet small bottom label “02 / PAPER”. Screenshot should look like a beautifully designed real desktop app.

Direction 03 — MIDNIGHT. Dense yet readable precision developer cockpit. Distinct horizontal architecture: a compact top global bar with DashAI at left, project switcher, global navigation and user/settings at right. NO broad permanent left sidebar. Direction 04 — SAGE. A calm contemporary workspace prioritizing WHAT NEEDS ATTENTION. Distinct asymmetrical content layout: after compact title and project navigation, main content uses a WIDE flat review queue on left (60%) and a clean CONTEXT PANE on right (40%).
